title: SIAc
description: Technical companion mod for the SIA2: Rivalation server.
body:
![SIAc mod for SIA2: Rivalation](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ae4ed5e2b8082c31e94a7f409447b2bef16bb517.png)



SIAc: Core Companion Mod 
SIAc is a specialized technical modification developed exclusively for the SIA2: Rivalation server infrastructure. It acts as a bridge between the player's client and the server's unique gameplay systems.

⚠️ Important Notice
This mod is strictly intended for players of the SIA2: Rivalation server. It relies on a private server-side plugin to function. Without this specific environment, the mod provides no features and has no impact on your game in single-player or on other servers.

Key Features:

-Media Synchronization: Allows the server to stream and synchronize visual media content directly to the player's screen for enhanced atmospheric immersion.

-Security & Integrity: Includes a built-in module for verifying installed client-side modifications to ensure a fair play environment and prevent cheating.

-Server-Side Integration: Provides essential hooks for custom server scripts, story-related triggers, and advanced gameplay mechanics.

-Performance Stability: Optimized to handle specialized network packets between the client and the SIA2 server plugin without affecting FPS.
